description: BioShock (Irrational Games, 2007) — a sub-world of video_games. The finer concepts within one game, giving the concept-graph descent a third rung below video_games.

microtheory.name: bioshock
microtheory.definition: BioShock's world: the fallen objectivist city of Rapture, the mind-control trigger 'would you kindly', and the theme that a man chooses while a slave obeys.

concepts.name: would_you_kindly
concepts.definition: BioShock's mind-control trigger phrase — a courtesy that is really a command.

concepts.name: a_man_chooses
concepts.definition: BioShock's thesis: 'a man chooses, a slave obeys' — the assertion of autonomy.

concepts.name: rapture
concepts.definition: The underwater city built by Andrew Ryan, setting of BioShock.

concepts.name: andrew_ryan
concepts.definition: Rapture's founder, an objectivist industrialist; the game's tragic antagonist.

concepts.name: atlas_fontaine
concepts.definition: The manipulator who weaponises 'would you kindly' against the player.

concepts.name: splicer
concepts.definition: A gene-spliced, ADAM-addicted inhabitant of Rapture — the game's common enemy.

concepts.name: big_daddy
concepts.definition: An armoured protector bonded to a Little Sister in Rapture.

concepts.name: little_sister
concepts.definition: A conditioned child who harvests ADAM, guarded by a Big Daddy.

concepts.name: plasmid
concepts.definition: A genetic tonic granting powers, bought with ADAM, in BioShock.

concepts.name: mind_control_trigger
concepts.definition: A conditioned phrase that compels obedience — BioShock's central device.
